_comment: Proposed content for game/data/encounters.json, in the format design/encounters.md decides. Kept in design/proto because it has not been through an engine; combat_solver.py reads it instead of carrying its own table, and farm/agreements.py validates it. An encounter is atomic — who fights whom. Which encounter occurs, where, and in what world state is a region's question and deliberately not expressible here.

encounters.note: M3's proof battle, re-paired per design/first_blood_balance.md. Every correct target is diagonal, which is what forces the Front/Back reach rule into the fight.

The pre-repair roster. Kept because it is the counter-example every balance document cites: unwinnable by any explainable plan. It is deliberately not a valid encounter and excludes itself from sweeps by failing to discriminate.

design/second_encounter.md. Diagonal like first_blood, and mixed-type on purpose: a one-type enemy line cannot make a fight that rewards skill, because a creature whose attacks are all resisted never banks a Charge. Ashmoth is the visitor that wandered up from the kilns.
